HERA, revered ancient Greek queen of the Olympians and goddess of marriage, women, SKY and STARS, shown as a dignified noble ADULT WOMAN seated upright on a great GOLDEN THRONE. ONE head, TWO normal eyes, TWO arms, TWO legs, natural respectful anatomy, mature regal face and composed commanding expression, not monstrous or villainous. Put a substantial Greek POLOS CROWN on her head and a bridal veil draped behind her head and shoulders. Wear a FULLY OPAQUE royal midnight-blue ankle-length Greek robe and thick ivory-gold mantle covering chest, torso and legs securely; no transparency, cleavage or exposed body. Her right hand holds a tall physically solid GOLD ROYAL SCEPTRE tipped with a distinct LOTUS FLOWER, clearly not an orb or spear; left hand presents a small natural POMEGRANATE at her knee. Both hands and both sandalled feet readable, throne back frames her living face without a halo. Low camera angle from broad ancient stone sanctuary steps gives enormous monumental authority. Greek columns flank the sides and open toward the Argos/Mycenae-like distant mountain valley; above and behind the throne spreads a spectacular dark blue STAR-FILLED SKY, with ordinary stars at different brightnesses and silver cloud bands. Stars remain in sky, never on her skin or as magical missiles. Cinematic warm reflected temple light reveals gold throne and face, cool celestial atmosphere, rich original painted cloth/marble/metal textures. ONLY Hera, no other humanoid deities, no peacock, no lion, no lightning/fire/laser powers, no glowing eyes or magic glyphs, no modern movie/game/anime/comic design, no text/letters/logo/watermark/border, no gore or nudity. Make her look like the honoured queen of the immortals, not an ordinary seated portrait.
